values.task_boundary: Own only the Shepherd eligibility lifecycle, one non-policy verified-cut foundation API, its new module/test, and one additive serialized registration; leave Observatory, integrated proof, process/listener, UI, and cloud behavior outside scope.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The foundation returns an unconstructible VerifiedServingAuthorityCut only after existing sealed receipt/binding verification and durable Published commit; acquire creates at most one eligible Shepherd only from that cut and a newer valid permit.
AC-2: Replace atomically supersedes the prior grant without any observable dual-eligible state; revoke and expiry permanently reject stale replay.
AC-3: Same-operation identical retry is idempotent, conflicting retry and every stale/mismatched binding fail closed without mutation.
AC-4: Restart, pending/reconciled boundaries, corruption, rollback, and capacity failure preserve the last exact committed eligibility state.
AC-5: Receipts bind the exact transition and projection exposes only bounded redacted state with no raw authority or operational secrets.

AC-6: Product changes are exactly the Shepherd module/test, one bounded additive verified-cut API in serving_authority.rs, and one additive distributed/mod.rs registration; #274 and parent #205 remain untouched; focused tests, strict Clippy, scope proof, and exact-head review pass.
AC-7: Required CI is green, typed finish creates canonical #273 terminal authority, and its merge is ancestral before #274 changes shared registration.
dependencies: #274 shared registration waits for terminal and ancestral #273
non_goals: Any #272 modification beyond the additive non-policy verified-cut API
Migration #204, UI, cloud/provider action, paid runners, or release qualification
